title: Pairwise correlation matrix
description: Compute Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients for all pairs of numeric columns (excluding employee_id). Focus on the row/column for performance_rating.
method: pandas .corr() for Pearson; scipy.stats.spearmanr for Spearman. Generate annotated heatmap.
validation_check: framing.required_checks[0]: Compute pairwise correlations between all numeric features and performance_rating

title: Correlation significance with Bonferroni correction
description: For each pairwise correlation, compute the two-sided p-value. Apply Bonferroni correction for 28 tests (8-choose-2). Report which, if any, survive correction.
method: scipy.stats.pearsonr and spearmanr for p-values; multiply by 28 for Bonferroni; flag those with corrected p < 0.05.

expected_outputs.name: correlation_pvalues.json
expected_outputs.description: Dict of {pair: {pearson_p, spearman_p, bonferroni_pearson_p, bonferroni_spearman_p, significant}}

validation_check: framing.required_checks[1]: Test whether any predictor explains significant variance beyond chance

title: Baseline OLS regression
description: Fit OLS regression: performance_rating ~ years_experience + training_hours + team_size + projects_completed + satisfaction_score + commute_minutes + remote_pct + C(salary_band). Report R-squared, adjusted R-squared, F-statistic and its p-value, and per-coefficient p-values.
method: statsmodels OLS with one-hot encoded salary_band. Use statsmodels summary().
validation_check: framing.required_checks[2]: Run a baseline regression and compare R-squared to a null model

title: Permutation test for regression R-squared
description: Shuffle performance_rating 1000 times. For each permutation, fit the same OLS model and record R-squared. Compare the observed R-squared to this null distribution and compute an empirical p-value.
method: numpy.random.permutation on the target array; fit OLS each iteration; empirical p = (count of null R-squared >= observed R-squared + 1) / (1000 + 1).

expected_outputs.name: permutation_r2_hist.png
expected_outputs.description: Histogram of null R-squared values with observed R-squared marked as vertical line

validation_check: framing.required_checks[2]: Run a baseline regression and compare R-squared to a null (permuted-target) model

title: Feature distribution plots
description: Plot histograms with KDE overlays for all numeric columns (excluding employee_id). Annotate with mean, std, skewness, and kurtosis. Check whether distributions are consistent with common synthetic generators (uniform, normal).
method: matplotlib/seaborn histplot with kde=True in a 2x4 subplot grid. scipy.stats.skew and kurtosis.

expected_outputs.name: distributions.png
expected_outputs.description: 2x4 grid of histograms with KDE for each numeric feature

title: Commute minutes outlier and skew analysis
description: Analyse commute_minutes for right-skew and outliers. Compute IQR, identify values beyond 1.5*IQR upper fence. Generate boxplot. Compute skewness statistic.
method: IQR = Q3 - Q1; upper fence = Q3 + 1.5*IQR. scipy.stats.skew. seaborn boxplot.

expected_outputs.name: commute_outliers.json
expected_outputs.description: {q1, q3, iqr, upper_fence, lower_fence, n_outliers, pct_outliers, skewness}

validation_check: framing.required_checks[3]: Check commute_minutes for outliers and right-skew impact on model assumptions

title: Salary band feature profile comparison
description: For each numeric feature, run a Kruskal-Wallis H-test grouped by salary_band. Also compute group means and produce a grouped boxplot for performance_rating by salary_band.
method: scipy.stats.kruskal for each feature. Apply Bonferroni correction for 8 tests. seaborn boxplot for performance_rating by salary_band.
validation_check: framing.required_checks[4]: Verify salary_band levels have distinct feature profiles before treating as ordinal

title: Multicollinearity assessment via VIF
description: Compute Variance Inflation Factor for each numeric predictor. Flag any with VIF > 5 (moderate) or VIF > 10 (severe).
method: statsmodels.stats.outliers_influence.variance_inflation_factor on the design matrix of numeric predictors.
validation_check: framing.required_checks[5]: Assess multicollinearity among predictors before fitting multivariate models

title: PCA for latent structure detection
description: Run PCA on standardised numeric features (excluding employee_id). Produce a scree plot and a 2D biplot (PC1 vs PC2) coloured by salary_band. Compare explained variance ratios against the uniform baseline (1/7 per component).
method: sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler + sklearn.decomposition.PCA. matplotlib for scree plot and biplot.

expected_outputs.name: pca_screeplot.png
expected_outputs.description: Scree plot with horizontal line at 1/7 baseline

expected_outputs.name: pca_biplot.png
expected_outputs.description: PC1 vs PC2 scatter coloured by salary_band with feature loading arrows

expected_outputs.name: pca_variance.json
expected_outputs.description: List of explained variance ratios and cumulative variance

title: Non-linear relationship scatter plots
description: For each numeric predictor, plot a scatter against performance_rating with a LOWESS smoother overlay. Look for non-linear patterns that OLS would miss.
method: seaborn regplot with lowess=True, one subplot per feature in a 2x4 grid.

expected_outputs.name: scatter_lowess.png
expected_outputs.description: 2x4 grid of scatter plots with LOWESS overlay

title: Categorical independence test
description: Bin remote_pct into quartile buckets. Run chi-squared test of independence against salary_band. If salary_band and remote_pct are independent, this supports the pure-noise hypothesis.
method: pandas.cut for binning; scipy.stats.chi2_contingency on the contingency table.

title: Random Forest feature importance
description: Fit a Random Forest regressor with 5-fold cross-validation. Report cross-validated R-squared (expect near zero if noise). Compute permutation-based feature importances.

expected_outputs.name: feature_importance.png
expected_outputs.description: Horizontal bar chart of permutation importances with error bars
